snippet.title: Fresh Tracks Launch Trailer | PC & PS5
snippet.description:
Fresh Tracks is out now on Steam and PS5! Hit the slopes in this rhythm roguelite on skis - choose your path, and become a legend 💪⛷️
.
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3202950/Fresh_Tracks/
PlayStation: https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10013297
